newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-FIRST ROUND TO REAL IN KAREMBEU BATTLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FIRST ROUND TO REAL IN KAREMBEU BATTLE.

text.p: Real Madrid seem to have come out on top in the battle with Barcelona to sign Sampdoria midfielder Christian Karembeu, but the date when the French international will join Real is still far from clear.
"I gave my word of honour to (Real) coach Fabio Capello and president Lorenzo Sanz, and I won't go back on it," said Karembeu in an interview published by the Spanish sports daily As on Friday.

The Madrid club reached a verbal agreement to sign Karembeu as a free agent when his contract at Sampdoria finishes in 1998, while Barcelona and Sampdoria had agreed terms for his transfer next month.
Karembeu, who has admitted that he was "in a bit of a mess," has been photographed wearing the shirts of both teams.
